**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer with strong hands\-on experience in React.js and modern frontend engineering. The ideal candidate should be able to build scalable web applications, integrate backend APIs, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and contribute to AI\-enabled or agentic workflow integrations where needed.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Develop, maintain, and enhance frontend applications using React.js. • Build reusable UI components and frontend libraries for future use. • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs using REST and/or GraphQL. • Work with backend teams to understand API contracts, authentication, request/response structures, and error handling. • Ensure responsive, accessible, and high\-performance user interfaces across browsers and devices. • Manage application state using Redux, Context API, Zustand, MobX, or similar tools. • Write clean, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews. • Debug and resolve frontend, API integration, and performance\-related issues. • Collaborate with UI/UX designers to convert wireframes and mockups into functional interfaces. • Support integration of AI or agentic workflows, including API\-based assistants, tool\-calling flows, or automated user actions


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


5\+ years of professional experience in frontend development. • Strong hands\-on experience with React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\. • Good working knowledge of TypeScript. • Experience integrating backend services through REST APIs and/or GraphQL. • Understanding of authentication flows such as JWT, OAuth, or session\-based authentication. • Experience with state management libraries such as Redux, Context API, Zustand, or MobX. • Familiarity with modern frontend build tools such as Vite, Webpack, or Babel. • Experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and agile development practices. • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills. • Basic understanding of agentic AI integrations, LLM\-based APIs, or AI\-powered workflows


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


Experience with Next.js or other React\-based frameworks. • Knowledge of Node.js or backend fundamentals. • Exposure to OpenAI APIs, LangChain, agent frameworks, or function/tool\-calling integrations. • Experience with UI libraries such as Material UI, Ant Design, Chakra UI, or Tailwind CSS. • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.

**Job Description**



Develop IIoT systems and ensure seamless integration and functionality within the Advantage\+Elite monitoring platform. Oversee the installation of prototype IoT devices and networks in industrial environments, ensuring system compatibility, stable connectivity, and efficient data collection and processing.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and implement IIoT devices and systems with integrated software and network interfaces.


* Create and maintain secure, reliable IIoT architectures that ensure consistent data flow between devices and cloud platforms.


* Collaborate with cross functional teams (product managers, hardware engineers, data scientists) to define system requirements and deliver complete IIoT solutions.


* Conduct research and development to evaluate emerging IoT technologies, platforms, and methodologies for potential implementation.


* Test, validate, and troubleshoot IIoT systems to ensure stability, efficiency, and security.


* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to data privacy, cybersecurity, and IoT device interoperability.


* Provide technical documentation including architecture diagrams, user guides, and system specifications.


* Monitor the performance of deployed IIoT systems and implement updates or upgrades to hardware and software components.


* Stay current with trends and advancements in IoT, cloud, and edge technologies to drive innovation.


**Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience


* 3\+ years of experience in a related industry.


* Strong understanding of Azure services and cloud architecture, including their use cases and deployment patterns.


* Proficiency in programming languages such as C\#, .NET, Java, Node.js, or Python, plus scripting tools like Azure CLI or PowerShell.


* Knowledge of Azure security and identity management, including RBAC and Azure Active Directory.


* Experience with data management and analytics tools such as Azure Data Factory, Kusto, or Azure Synapse Analytics.


* Familiarity with microservices architectures and containerization technologies such as Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

* **3\+ years of experience** in performance marketing, advertising creative, paid social, paid search, or a similar design role, preferably within e\-commerce.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Canva and/or Figma**.
* Experience creating both static and motion\-based advertising creatives.
* Practical experience using **AI creative and localization tools**, including generative image/video and AI translation.
* Basic video editing skills for short\-form advertising content.
* Understanding of advertising platform specifications, formats, aspect ratios, safe zones, and text limitations.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with multiple localized creative versions.
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced, high\-volume production environment.
* Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience creating creatives for **Meta Ads, Google Shopping, and Performance Max**.
* Understanding of how advertising creatives influence campaign performance.
* Familiarity with **UGC\-style and short\-form paid social content**.
* Knowledge of **German, French, Italian, Spanish, or Dutch** is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Experience in **sports, fitness, consumer goods, or e\-commerce** is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistent delivery of high\-quality creative assets
* Fast turnaround from brief to campaign\-ready creative
* Accurate localization across multiple European markets
* Strong contribution to creative testing and iteration
* Brand\-consistent and platform\-ready assets with minimal rework

You'll own the pipeline end\-to\-end: from concept and AI\-generated raw footage/avatars/voiceovers to polished, launch\-ready motion graphics for Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, and product pages.

* Partner with the design and marketing team on creative briefs, storyboards, and the content calendar

* Keep brand voice, colors, and typography consistent across every AI\-assisted and traditionally produced asset
* Organize footage, AI\-generated assets, and project files for fast iteration and reuse across campaigns

* 1–3 years of experience in motion graphics, video editing, or content creation — e\-commerce or D2C brand experience is a strong plus
* Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video generation or AI avatar tool (Runway, Pika, Kling, HeyGen, Synthesia, or similar)

* A strong sense of UGC\-style storytelling — hooks, pacing, and native formatting for each platform
* A portfolio or reel demonstrating short\-form video and/or motion graphics work
* Sharp visual design instincts — typography, color, and brand consistency

**Nice to Have**

* Working knowledge of AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL·E, or similar)
* Familiarity with paid social ad specs (Meta, TikTok)
* Basic scripting or copywriting skills for video hooks and captions
